title: Date Night
blurb: Sweet questions and flirty dares for couples. Pick Spicy for the cheekier half.

truth: What was your first impression of your partner or date?
What's the most romantic thing anyone has ever done for you?
What does your perfect lazy Sunday together look like?
What's a love song you secretly know every word of?
What's the cheesiest pickup line you know? Deliver it.
What's the best date you've ever been on?
What's a small thing someone can do that instantly wins you over?
Which movie couple would you most like to be?
What's your most embarrassing moment in front of a crush?
What's one thing on your relationship bucket list?
What's the worst date idea you can think of?
What's a quality you find surprisingly attractive?
Who made the first move in your last relationship?
What's the sweetest message you've ever received?
Breakfast in bed or dinner out: which wins and why?
What's a tiny habit of a past partner that you secretly miss?
What song would be playing in the movie of your love life?
What's the best thing you've ever cooked for someone you liked?
Do you prefer big romantic gestures or small daily ones, and why?
What's the first thing you notice about someone you've just met?
What's the most spontaneous thing you'd do for love?
What's your love language, and does it match what you actually do?
What's the nicest thing a stranger has said about you and a partner?
dare: Serenade the group with one line of a love song, full drama.
Give the person on your right your most sincere compliment.
Recreate a famous movie romance scene using your hands as the actors.
Describe your dream date in exactly ten words.
Slow dance with an imaginary partner for 20 seconds.
Write a two-line love poem about something on the table and read it aloud.
Text a friend a heartfelt thank-you message right now.
Give a dramatic rom-com speech declaring your love for your favourite food.
Plan the perfect picnic out loud, from the blanket to dessert.
Hold eye contact with the person on your left for 20 seconds without laughing.
Act out the moment someone gets a text from their crush.
Invent a couple name for any two people in the room.
Play a nervous first date trying to order food.
Tell the love story of two objects on the table.
Show the group the most romantic photo on your phone you're happy to share.
Give a two-minute best-man or maid-of-honour speech for an imaginary wedding in this room.
Convince the group you'd be the perfect date to a very fancy ball, with three reasons.
Narrate the couple across from you like a wildlife documentary on courtship.
Perform a dramatic proposal to a pot plant, complete with a ring made from anything handy.
Write a three-word love note to everyone in the room and hand them out.
Pick a song and lip sync the most romantic line like it's the final scene of a movie.
Try to make the person on your left blush using only a compliment about their taste in music.
Draw your partner or the person on your left in 30 seconds without looking down, then show it off.

truth: What's the cheekiest thing you've ever done to get someone's attention?
What's your biggest turn-off on a date?
Who was your most unexpected crush?
What's the boldest message you've ever sent to someone you liked?
What's the longest you've had a crush on someone without telling them?
What's something you find attractive that you'd never admit on a first date?
Have you ever had a dream about someone you shouldn't have? No names needed.
What's the most awkward way a date has ever ended for you?
What's the best kiss you've ever had, and what made it so good?
What's a secret you've never told a partner?
Which celebrity is your free pass?
Where's the most unusual place you've ever been kissed?
dare: Read out the last message you sent with a heart in it.
Whisper the cheesiest pickup line you can think of to the person on your left.
Do your most seductive walk across the room.
Give the person on your right a two-line flirty compliment.
Describe your ideal kiss using only food words.
Let the person on your left pick an emoji from your recent list for you to act out.
Do a slow-motion hair flip and wink at someone of your choice.
Act out flirting with someone across a crowded bar without using any words.
Let the group write you a dating profile bio, then read it out proudly.
Kiss the hand of the person on your left like a knight, if they're happy to.
Read the ingredients of something in the kitchen in your flirtiest voice.
Show the group the last flirty GIF or meme you sent.
